hero.text: Stone-milled in small batches, traced to the farmer who grew them. MilletLuxe brings India's oldest grains to your kitchen — unrefined, unhurried, unforgettable.

intro.title: A grain that fed civilizations, forgotten by convenience
intro.text: For five thousand years, millets sustained entire regions on rainfall alone. As modern agriculture chased yield over resilience, this quiet grain was pushed to the margins — until now.

story.title: From one dying seed bank to a movement
paragraphs: MilletLuxe began in 2016 when our founder, visiting a seed conservation center in Telangana, discovered that six local millet varieties were on the verge of disappearing entirely — replaced by high-yield rice and wheat monocultures that demanded irrigation the region could no longer sustain.

What started as an effort to preserve a handful of heirloom seeds grew into a farmer collective spanning five states. Today we work with over 1,200 growers, paying above fair-trade rates and reinvesting a share of every sale into seed banking and soil regeneration programs.
Every pack that reaches your kitchen carries a story — a region, a season, a family who tended it. We simply mill it, and get out of the way.
